data_provenance.clinical_validation: NONE — synthetic data only. Requires MIMIC-IV or institutional EHR validation.
data_provenance.regulatory_note: NOT suitable for clinical claims. Research use only.

method: Both arms use identical patient-level train, validation, and held-out test splits. The no-labs arm excludes lactate, WBC, procalcitonin, all derived lab trajectories, and every lab-missingness indicator before retraining.
limitations: The cohort is generated by a hand-authored synthetic data process.
The result is not clinical validation and cannot establish performance in patients.
External retrospective and prospective validation remain required.
